content: Served as an active functionary within the Information Technology Student Association. Assigned to the Cooperative Division, where I was responsible for managing entrepreneurial activities, handling internal administration, and supporting the financial sustainability of the association's programs through creative fundraising.
content_id: Bertugas sebagai fungsionaris aktif di Himpunan Mahasiswa Teknologi Informasi. Ditempatkan di Divisi Koprasi dengan tanggung jawab mengelola kegiatan kewirausahaan, menangani administrasi internal, dan mendukung keberlanjutan finansial program-program himpunan melalui penggalangan dana kreatif.
